Package com.egradx.notification.delivery

Record Class EgradxBulkSendView

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.egradx.notification.delivery.EgradxBulkSendView
Record Components:
status - EXPANDING while deliveries are still being created, COMPLETE once everyone has been reached or counted, FAILED with lastError if the template stopped rendering
recipientsExpanded - deliveries created so far — each is then sent, and logged, like any other
unreachable - audience members with no address on the channel
optedOut - audience members skipped because they opted out — only when the send honours preferences
messageIds - one per language so far; their deliveries are the delivery log
public record EgradxBulkSendView(UUID id, UUID organizationId, String channel, EgradxRecipientDirectory.Kind audience, UUID audienceOrganizationId, String notificationKey, EgradxBulkSendEntity.Status status, int recipientsExpanded, int unreachable, int optedOut, String lastError, List<UUID> messageIds, Instant createdAt, Instant updatedAt) extends Record
A bulk send's progress.
